related.title: 浮式太陽能電站繫泊設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；浮式太陽能電站繫泊設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Floating Solar Plant Mooring Design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海邊工業區裡的光電場：颱風的掀力、潮差下的水面繫泊與鹽霧腐蝕；浮式太陽能電站繫泊設計則以把五萬片模組繫在水面上：浮力、整島風力、錨繩張力、錨塊重量與連接件的累積拉力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on solar plants in a seaside industrial park: typhoon uplift, mooring on water with tides and salt-mist corrosion; Floating Solar Plant Mooring Design centres on holding fifty thousand modules on water: buoyancy, wind on the whole island, mooring tension, anchor weight and accumulated connector load, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「颱風對模組的掀力」的模型移到浮式太陽能電站繫泊設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「錨塊所需的水中重量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Typhoon uplift on modules" to Floating Solar Plant Mooring Design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Submerged anchor weight needed", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；浮式太陽能電站繫泊設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Floating Solar Plant Mooring Design must be respecified.

related.title: 大彰化離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大彰化離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海邊工業區裡的光電場：颱風的掀力、潮差下的水面繫泊與鹽霧腐蝕；大彰化離岸風電場則以臺灣最大的離岸風場：60 Hz 長距離輸出海纜、吸力桶基礎與企業購電合約為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on solar plants in a seaside industrial park: typhoon uplift, mooring on water with tides and salt-mist corrosion; Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms centres on taiwan's largest offshore wind farm: long 60 Hz export cables, suction-bucket foundations and a corporate power purchase agreement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「颱風對模組的掀力」的模型移到大彰化離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「吸力桶的下沉力」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Typhoon uplift on modules" to Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sinking force of a suction bucket", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「I–V 曲線與填充因子」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大彰化離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "I–V curve and fill factor" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms must be respecified.

history.title: 彰濱太陽光電場
history.text: 2017 年政府推動太陽光電兩年計畫；2019 年台電彰濱 100 MW 光電場完工；2020 年水面型光電場完工；2023 年臺灣光電裝置容量超過 1,200 萬 kW。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2017: The government launched a two-year solar push. 2019: Taipower's 100 MW Changbin plant was completed. 2020: The floating plant was completed. 2023: Taiwan's photovoltaic capacity passed 12 GW. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
